'''Events''' ---- ''For information about Passes, click [[Passes|here]].'' '''Events''' are a celebration of sorts and include limited-time maps and enemies. They normally reward an exclusive tower that cannot be bought with {{Coins|Coins}}. After an event has concluded, you can no longer play the event maps in the event (unless the map is re-released as a regular map), nor can you get any of the exclusive towers. {| class="empty-table
